description: Puts a new photo, found by words, into a photo frame of the design (the biggest, a given one, or every artboard’s): from Unsplash, or from Paletoo’s own photo library when no photo service is set up. Use it for «use a photo of a dog instead», «a darker photo». Example: { design, photo: «golden retriever at the vet» }.

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

every_artboard.description: true: each artboard’s photo frame (a post and its story)

layer.description: a photo’s id from get_design; none: the biggest frame

photo.description: IN ENGLISH, what the photo should show

name: replace_photo
title: Replace a photo
